name.en: The 61st annual exhibition of the Keuruu Artists' Association

short_description.en: The 6.1. annual exhibition of the Keuruun Artists' Association will be held in the traditional manner at the Keuruun Museum in October-November.

description.en: The annual exhibition is the only exhibition of the association where any resident of Keuruu or Multia has the opportunity to offer 1-3 of their works as candidates for the exhibition. The year in which the work was made is no longer relevant. You can submit works for the annual exhibition that have not been previously displayed in the museum's premises. An external person who is not connected to the association serves as the juror for the annual exhibition of the Artists' Association. A person who has participated in two juried annual exhibitions (where their work has been selected for the exhibition) can become a member of the Keuruu Artists' Association. One of the exhibitions can be replaced by other artistic merits. name.en: Webinar on Guardianship of Attorney - Remote Viewing

short_description.en: What should a person with a memory disorder know about a power of attorney?

description.en: What should a person with a memory disorder know about power of attorney? In this online seminar, you will receive practical basic information about power of attorney. With a power of attorney, you can decide in advance who will take care of your affairs if you can no longer manage them yourself due to illness, accident or other reason. You will hear, among other things, - what issues are worth considering when planning a power of attorney - when and how a power of attorney comes into effect - how the power of attorney representative should act The free online seminar is aimed at people with memory disorders, their loved ones and others interested in the topic. The lecturer is lawyer Sari Elomaa from the Muistiliitto (Memory Association). The remote viewing is organized at the Keuruu main library. No pre-registration required.

short_description.en: Keuruu Cultural Center Kimara gig on Saturday 7.11.26 starting at 19:00.

description.en: Jenni Mustajärvi is a singer/songwriter who has released one album and several singles during her career. A singer navigating the Finnish-language pop rock scene, she writes her own songs. "It's important to me that the songs I sing have some connection to myself. That's how conveying emotion to the audience works and hopefully the listener can identify with the songs I've written." "If I can evoke some feeling in the listener, then my job is done," Jenni reflects. Jenni believes that a relaxed and good vibe as well as the connection created with the audience is the recipe for a successful gig that leaves everyone with a positive memory. Jenni performs in Keuruu with her band. An hour before, during the intermission, and an hour after the gig, Bistro Fiilis bar services are available in Kimara's warm-up room. The gig is in collaboration with Keuruu cultural services.

description.fi: Tilaisuudessa Suomi-Kenia Seuran Erkki Kyllönen ja keuruulaislähtöinen Ossi Leppänen kertovat Leppäsen kokoaman Maasaikansan viisauksia -kirjan (Rosebud Books, 2025) värikkään syntyhistorian ja keskustelevat heimon iskevistä ja tarttuvista aforismeista. Kirjan idea on ollut yhdistää maasaikansan vanhoja viisauksia kirjoittajan vuosina 1980-1982 ottamiin autenttisiin valokuviin Kenian maasaialueelta. Aforismit ovat kolmella kielellä, suomeksi, englanniksi sekä maa-kielellä. Aforismeihin sisältyy paljon viisautta nykyhetkeenkin sovitettuna. Kuten esimerkiksi; "Älä yritä kulkea kahta polkua, siinä menee lantio hajalle." Se olisi hyvä neuvo monelle nykypäivän kiireiselle multitaskaajalle. Tai kun sanotaan; "Takamus ja maankamara eivät kauaa viihdy erossa toisistaan." Olisiko niin, että valtuustojen päätökset olisivat ympäristön kannalta parempia, jos kokoukset pidettäisiin maasaitten tapaan lehtevän puun katveessa istuen? Maa-kielisessä kulttuurissa kuten varmaan muissakin kulttuureissa esiintyy sanonta: "Vanhuus ja viisaus". Näin se juuri on kirjan esittelijöidenkin mielestä, eivät kaik…

short_description.fi: Laulaja Emma Salokosken ja kitaristi Jarmo Saaren herkkä ja kuulas duo yhdistää kaksi Suomen musiikkikentän arvostetuinta ja persoonallisinta taiteilijaa.

description.fi: Laulaja Emma Salokosken ja kitaristi Jarmo Saaren herkkä, intiimi ja kuulas duo yhdistää kaksi Suomen musiikkikentän arvostetuinta ja persoonallisinta taiteilijaa. Emma Salokosken ja Jarmo Saaren Kaksin -konsertti kutsuu kuulijan pysähtymään ja kokemaan musiikin ainutlaatuisen voiman. Luvassa on tarkasti valikoituja kappaleita molempien artistien urien varsilta tuoreina ja intiimeinä sovituksina sekä yhteiseltä, vuonna 2023 julkaistulta “Viileässä virrassa” -albumilta. Musiikin keskiössä on kahden muusikon välinen vuoropuhelu, jota kannattelee Salokosken puhdistava ja vahva ääni sekä Saaren kitaransoiton maalaileva virtuositeetti. Suomen eturivin artisteihin kuuluva Emma Salokoski on pitkällä urallaan vaikuttanut useissa kokoonpanoissa ja julkaissut lukuisia albumeja. Laulaja on esiintynyt niin sinfoniaorkesterien solistina kuin rockfestivaalien päälavoilla. Hänen tunnetuimpia yhtyeitään ovat Emma Salokoski Ensemble, Emma Salokoski & Ilmiliekki sekä vokaaliyhtyeet Emma Salokoski Voices ja Aito Collective. Duon toinen osapuoli Jarmo Saari on maan omaleimaisimpia kitaristeja. Yhtyeistä…

description.en: We kick off the "Keuruu Lights" (Keuruun Valot) weekend on Friday with a "Night of Shopping" (Ostosten Yö), featuring special offers from local Keuruu businesses. Supermarkets and the brick-and-mortar shops in the town center will extend their opening hours. At Keuruu Church, we begin the "Light Path" (Valopolku) festivities with a preview event, featuring a video light installation from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. On Saturday, the "Light Path" (Valopolku) event continues from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Wander along this magical path to discover stunning light installations and various performances at the central square, the market square, and the waterfront by the library. The route covers approximately 1.5 km and winds through the center of Keuruu. Keuruu Church will once again host a spectacular video light installation—an attraction that drew a couple of thousand visitors last year. At the Local History Museum (Kotiseutumuseo) next to the church, you can visit Santa Claus’s cabin to share your Christmas wish list and even try your hand at "fishing" for a Christmas treat. At the Keuruu Library,…

Katri on julkaissut kuusi albumia ja kaksi kokoelmalevyä. Katri juhlistaa 20-vuotista taiteilijavuottaan keikkailemalla ympäri Suomen. Katrin uran suurimpia hittejä ovat mm. Yksi sydän, Sano mulle jotain kaunista, Onko vielä aikaa?, Välitunnilla, Aamuaurinkoon ja Valehdellaan, sekä Mansikkamäki. Liput ostettavissa etukäteen Keuruun kaupungin verkkokaupasta. description.en: Welcome to spend an unforgettable gala evening with us, where delicious food, wonderful music, and the opportunity to do good come together! From each dinner ticket sold, a portion will be donated to the Brain Injury Association to support their valuable work. Additionally, during the evening a charity auction will be held, where each association/company gets to auction one item. The proceeds from these items will be directed in full directly to the important charitable causes chosen by the associations themselves. name.en: World's End Safari - Tarmo Heinonen's filmed material's journey into a documentary

short_description.en: The film and TV producer Toni Panula's lecture covers the journey of the material filmed in Australia in the 1960s and 1970s by the Keuruu-based Tarmo Heinonen, to become a documentary.

description.en: Toni Panula's lecture "Maailmanlopun safari" (Doomsday Safari) addresses Tarmo Heinonen's material filmed in Australia in the 1960s and 1970s, the state of the oceans, and the journey of the film footage to become a documentary. This free public lecture is organized in collaboration with Keuruu Museum and Library. No pre-registration required.
